body:
Cannot complete #1875 until its prerequisite #1873 provides the cadmpeg runner and shared qualified-extension table.
Checked upstream/main 8719d8b7a028f0c93cc78fe32ccbfdf5297a0dca against GitHub's current main.
The tree has no cadmpeg references. checked_budget in crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs still refuses IGES directly.
#1873 is open and has no PR to stack on. Its latest progress comment reports that cadmpeg 0.6.12 does not support the requested formats --json probe and leaves the capability contract unresolved.
The anticipated importer, qualification test, matrix document, and decision-file paths have no open PR overlaps.
Stopped before claiming. No worktree, code changes, pins, mutations, or gate runs were made.

blocked: waiting on prerequisite `#1873` and an upstream `cadmpeg` capability-contract decision, plus `cadmpeg` and clean-room native CAD fixtures.

Checked `upstream/main` at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239` and open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- `#1873` (`Core cadmpeg runner, version check, and temp-dir sandbox in camcraft-app`) is still open with no open or merged PR to stack on. Its latest comment reports that `cadmpeg` v0.6.12 does not support `cadmpeg formats --json` (`Formats` prints a text table), leaving the machine-readable capability contract unresolved and escalated to `effort:max`.
- `upstream/main` has no `cadmpeg` references (`git grep -n cadmpeg`), no `cadmpeg_path` in `crates/app/src/prefs.rs`, and no shared qualified-extension table in `camcraft-app`: `checked_budget` in `crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs` still refuses `.iges`/`.igs` directly, and `format_from_path` in `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs` accepts only `stl`, `obj`, `step`, and `stp`.
- `cadmpeg` (`>= 0.6.12`) is not installed on this host (`which cadmpeg` returned not found), and `#1875`'s scope also depends on inspecting `cadmpeg formats --json`.
- No clean-room native CAD or IGES fixtures exist in the repository (`examples/models` contains only `first-part.obj`).

Added label `blocked` so `#1875` is not re-picked before `#1873` lands and `cadmpeg`/fixtures are available. Stopped before claiming `#1875`; made no branch, worktree, code change, or PR.
